description: Points d'accès Wi-Fi publics de la Ville de Genève is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Stadt Genf. Toujours très dynamique en matière de démocratisation de l'accès à Internet, la Ville de Genève propose au public un réseau de points d'accès Wi-Fi gratuits. Pour se connecter au réseau, il faut se situer dans une zone d'accès Wi-Fi couverte par l'émetteur de la Ville de Genève, puis sélectionner le réseau "ville-geneve". Coverage: Stadt Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Stadt Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
